rdf:Description.dc:title: Tamaki Miura performing at the Sylvan Theatre
rdf:Description.dc:description: Tamaki Miura performed an aria from Madame Butterfly as part of the opening performance for the Sylvan Theatre on the Washington Monument grounds in June 1917. Miura was a Japanese opera singer who toured Europe and the United States in the 1910s and 1920s.
rdf:Description.dc:source: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division. View original.
